changes.title: Ram lynx shapes
items: Lynxes stand tall on long legs, with big tufted ears
Young rams show their first curling horns, and adult rams stand on slimmer legs under their fleece

changes.title: Legs no outline
items: Animals’ legs no longer have outlines in the bold style, so each leg reads as one limb, not a stack of beads

changes.title: Champion tuned
items: The champion bot plays with the numbers its overnight search found: it lasts longer than the skilled bot on maps it never trained on
